fact: TechReviewAfrica reports the official handover of Zimbabwe's Enterprise Architecture Model blueprint, expected to guide the integration of government digital systems and public services; the handover date is not given, so the article's published date is used.

The ICT Minister states that the Enterprise Architecture Model blueprint was officially handed over to the nation's ICT Directors at an e-Government Unit conference the day before her post of 2026-05-08, with a Government Service Bus planned for once-only data sharing across ministries.

The e-Governance Academy says it completed an enterprise architecture framework, roadmap and change plan for the Government of Zimbabwe in a project running September 2023 to September 2024, with staff from over 40 MDAs in workshops, and that the model is now in place; the page gives no year, so the project end is used.
